topic: Eight-thousanders (peaks above 8,000 m): there are 14 on Earth, all in the Himalaya and Karakoram. Nepal contains or shares 8: Everest, Kangchenjunga, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, Dhaulagiri, Manaslu and Annapurna. Pakistan has 5 (K2, Nanga Parbat, Gasherbrum I, Gasherbrum II, Broad Peak); China has 5 (Everest, Lhotse, Makalu and Cho Oyu shared with Nepal, plus Shishapangma entirely in Tibet). Of Nepal's eight, Everest, Lhotse, Makalu and Cho Oyu stand on the China border and Kangchenjunga on the India border; Dhaulagiri, Manaslu and Annapurna rise entirely inside Nepal. Everest's height was jointly announced by Nepal and China in December 2020 as 8,848.86 m. The southern approach starts from the Tenzing-Hillary airstrip at Lukla.
